mapper.select: SELECT SETTLEMENT_SETTING_SN, PLATFORM_FEE_RATE, CARD_FEE_RATE, VAT_RATE, SETTLEMENT_BASIS_CD, DEPOSIT_DUE_DAYS, SETTLEMENT_CYCLE_CD, MIN_SETTLEMENT_AMT, AUTO_INVOICE_YN, TAX_INVOICE_YN, MDFCN_DT FROM SETTLEMENT_SETTING WHERE SETTLEMENT_SETTING_SN = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE SETTLEMENT_SETTING SET PLATFORM_FEE_RATE = #{platformFeeRate}, CARD_FEE_RATE = #{cardFeeRate}, VAT_RATE = #{vatRate}, SETTLEMENT_BASIS_CD = #{settlementBasisCd}, DEPOSIT_DUE_DAYS = #{depositDueDays}, SETTLEMENT_CYCLE_CD = #{settlementCycleCd}, MIN_SETTLEMENT_AMT = #{minSettlementAmt}, AUTO_INVOICE_YN = #{autoInvoiceYn}, TAX_INVOICE_YN = #{taxInvoiceYn}, MDFCN_DT = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), MDFR_SN = #{mdfrSn} WHERE SETTLEMENT_SETTING_SN = 1
mapper.select: SELECT R.PRTNR_SN AS PRTNR_SN, MAX(P.CONM) AS PRTNR_CONM, COALESCE(SUM(PM.PAY_AMT), 0) AS TOTAL_SALES_AMT, MAX(PS.PARTNER_SETTLEMENT_SN) AS EXECUTED_SN, MAX(PS.EXECUTED_AT) AS EXECUTED_AT FROM RESERVATION R JOIN PRTNR_MST P ON P.PRTNR_SN = R.PRTNR_SN JOIN PAYMENT PM ON PM.RESERVATION_SN = R.RESERVATION_SN AND PM.PAYMENT_STTS_CD = 'APPROVED' AND PM.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN PARTNER_SETTLEMENT PS ON PS.ROUND_YM = #{roundYm} AND PS.PRTNR_SN = R.PRTNR_SN WHERE R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND DATE_FORMAT(R.CHECK_OUT_DATE, '%Y-%m') = #{roundYm} GROUP BY R.PRTNR_SN ORDER BY R.PRTNR_SN

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(PM.PAY_AMT), 0) FROM RESERVATION R JOIN PAYMENT PM ON PM.RESERVATION_SN = R.RESERVATION_SN AND PM.PAYMENT_STTS_CD = 'APPROVED' AND PM.DEL_YN = 'N' WHERE R.DEL_YN = 'N' AND R.PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn} AND DATE_FORMAT(R.CHECK_OUT_DATE, '%Y-%m') = #{roundYm}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM PARTNER_SETTLEMENT WHERE ROUND_YM = #{roundYm} AND PRTNR_SN = #{prtnrSn}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTNER_SETTLEMENT (ROUND_YM, PRTNR_SN, TOTAL_SALES_AMT, CARD_FEE_AMT, PLATFORM_FEE_AMT, SETTLEMENT_AMT, SETTLEMENT_STTS_CD, EXECUTED_AT, REG_DT, RGTR_SN, MDFCN_DT, MDFR_SN) VALUES (#{roundYm}, #{prtnrSn}, #{totalSalesAmt}, #{cardFeeAmt}, #{platformFeeAmt}, #{settlementAmt}, 'COMPLETED', UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{rgtrSn})
